purpose: Authorize forward PAPER evidence collection for the frozen PureArb champion only; not evidence of profitability and not authorization for real order submission.
operator_instruction: Freeze the current model as champion; run PAPER 24/7 from London without changing parameters; record complete book, theoretical/net edge, size, latency stages, survival at 1/5/10/25/50ms, counterfactual fills, leg risk and PnL.
review_conclusions: The frozen PureArb code path completed the bounded selected-AZ public-data PAPER validation cleanly with zero invalid pairs, zero one-leg fills and zero latency drops.
The selected-AZ evidence is sufficient to proceed with forward PAPER collection on euw2-az1.
The 180-second validation observed zero pair admissions and zero paired fills, so it is not evidence of profitability.
Authenticated order-to-matching-engine latency was not observed and remains outside the evidence claimed by this review.

The runtime maker artifact used to bootstrap the full PAPER supervisor must remain a COLD_START baseline with no learned rich model; it is infrastructure for PAPER collection, not a newly approved trading alpha.
